browser.all_workers_connected.description: Empty/add-state notice: each available Worker already has a Browser Use connection. It does not mean every browser tab is currently connected or every Worker is online.

browser.apply_update.description: Action applying the available bundled Browser Use preset update to this connection. It does not mean installing a new Chrome version or refreshing a website.

browser.bridge.instructions.description: Instructions for installing the Browser Bridge ZIP as an unpacked Chrome extension and explaining access to ordinary tabs/sign-ins in that profile. Keep chrome://extensions exact. Browser Bridge and Playwright Extension are product names; Developer mode is the Chrome setting.

browser.connect.description: Action creating a Browser Use connection for the selected Worker. It does not itself mean starting a model call or logging the user into a website.

browser.connection_summary.description: Whole connection summary: exact Worker ID, current availability status and number of advertised tools. Tools are callable browser operations, not tabs or extensions. Localize the status before interpolation and use numeric count for plurals.

argumentDescriptions.count: Number of browser tools advertised in this connection snapshot. Example: 12. It does not count tabs.
argumentDescriptions.status: Already localized status of the referenced Worker. English examples: online, offline, unavailable.
argumentDescriptions.workerId: Exact registered Worker identifier controlling the browser. Example: worker-7. Preserve unchanged.

browser.connection_summary_refresh.description: Whole connection summary with an extra notice that tool/catalog refresh is available. Refresh does not mean refreshing the currently open web page. Preserve the same Worker/status/tool-count meanings as the ordinary summary.

argumentDescriptions.count: Number of browser tools advertised in this connection snapshot. Example: 12. Numeric plural selector.
argumentDescriptions.status: Already localized status of the referenced Worker. English examples: online, offline, unavailable.
argumentDescriptions.workerId: Exact registered Worker identifier controlling the browser. Example: worker-7. Preserve unchanged.

browser.description.description: Explains that the model operates the user's actual Chrome session through Playwright on one exact Worker. Real session includes the existing browser profile, not a simulated/headless browser by implication.

browser.download_bridge.description: Action downloading the Gromozeka Browser Bridge extension package. Downloading does not itself install the extension; retain the product name.

browser.error.configuration.description: Browser Use settings: exact-Worker browser connections and Browser Bridge setup. Configuration.

browser.error.load_connections.description: Browser Use settings: exact-Worker browser connections and Browser Bridge setup. Load connections.

browser.error.test.description: Browser Use settings: exact-Worker browser connections and Browser Bridge setup. Test.

browser.no_workers.description: Empty state before any execution Worker has registered with the Server. It does not mean no AI Agents are configured.

browser.owner_only.description: Permission notice restricting connection management to the Server Owner role. Owner is the deployment role, not necessarily the owner of the Chrome profile or physical machine.

browser.preset_differs.description: Warning that the stored Playwright transport configuration differs from the bundled Browser Use preset. Preset is a configuration recipe, not a browser profile or selected tab.

browser.refresh.description: Action refreshing the connection's advertised tool snapshot. It does not refresh the user's active browser page.

browser.remove.description: Browser Use settings: exact-Worker browser connections and Browser Bridge setup. Remove.

browser.retry.description: Browser Use settings: exact-Worker browser connections and Browser Bridge setup. Retry.

browser.screenshot.capturing.description: Progress message while awaiting a screenshot through the selected Browser Use connection. Capture refers to creating an image of browser content, not capturing a user or seizing a device.

browser.screenshot.description.description: Accessible fallback description for a Browser Use test screenshot when no filename was provided. It describes an image, not a command to take another screenshot.

browser.screenshot.unreadable.description: Fallback message when the returned screenshot media cannot be decoded for display. The MIME media type is a literal technical identifier; unreadable does not mean that text inside the screenshot failed OCR.

argumentDescriptions.mediaType: Literal MIME type of the returned screenshot. Example: image/png. Preserve the technical value.

browser.status.unavailable.description: Fallback status when the Worker referenced by a stored connection cannot be resolved in the current Worker catalog. Do not equate it automatically with a known offline Worker.

browser.test.description: Action testing the configured Browser Use connection by requesting a screenshot from its Worker. It is not a unit-test suite or a claim that all browser functions were tested.

browser.title.description: Settings heading for model-driven operation of an existing Chrome profile through a Worker. Browser Use is a capability name; use terminology distinct from Browser Bridge, the separately installed extension.

browser.token.keep_hint.description: Explains that leaving the token field blank retains the secret already stored on the Server. Blank input does not remove the token in this operation.

browser.token.label.description: Field for a Browser Bridge/Playwright extension authentication token. Token means a secret credential, not an AI text token or a usage allowance.

browser.token.optional_hint.description: Explains an optional extension credential that avoids repeated approval dialogs. Keep PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_EXTENSION_TOKEN unchanged; it is the exact technical environment-variable name.

browser.token.remove.description: Action removing the stored extension credential from this connection. This is separate from deleting the Browser Use connection or removing the installed extension.

browser.token.replace.description: Action replacing the previously stored extension credential with the supplied token. It does not rotate a model API key or replace the browser profile.

browser.token.save.description: Action storing the supplied extension authentication token on the Server for this connection. Do not describe token values as text-processing units.

browser.validation.bundled_runtime.description: Validation error when attempting to configure a Browser Bridge token on an incompatible/non-bundled Browser Use runtime configuration. Runtime means the integration implementation here, not elapsed time.

browser.validation.token_required.description: Validation error for a blank extension authentication token. It concerns secret input, not a zero model token count.

browser.worker.label.description: Selector label for the exact execution Worker whose browser profile will be controlled. Worker is a registered software executor, not a human operator.

browser.worker.select.description: Placeholder asking the user to choose a registered Worker. Selecting a Worker does not change the browser's account by itself.

browser.worker_boundary.description: Explains that browser actions remain on the selected Worker's machine and are never rerouted automatically. Preserve the exact-executor guarantee.

browser.worker_offline.description: Disabled-action/status label when the selected registered Worker is not online. The Worker exists; this is different from no Worker being registered.

builtinStringsMode.description: Legacy mode label selecting interface strings shipped with the application, rather than a custom translation.
builtinStringsMode.usageNotes: No current production reference to this typed property was found in presentation/src. The source points to its declaration; the described role is its retained catalog intent.

builtinStringsTooltip.description: Legacy tooltip for selecting the application's bundled interface translation.
builtinStringsTooltip.usageNotes: No current production reference to this typed property was found in presentation/src. The source points to its declaration; the described role is its retained catalog intent.

cancelButton.description: Cancel button: dismiss an editor without saving, remove a queued message, or request cancellation of a command monitor. Use a neutral action verb suitable for these contexts.
cancelButton.translationNotes: Keep wording neutral because the same key cancels unsaved editing, a queued message, and a running monitor.

chat.activity.groupCount.description: Heading of a collapsed group of assistant thinking/tool activities.

argumentDescriptions.count: Thinking/tool activity entries collapsed into one chronological group.

chat.activity.interrupted.description: Accessibility label for a tool or reasoning activity that was interrupted. Final state, not currently stopping.

chat.activity.thinkingCount.description: Accessibility description for a thinking-activity icon and its count.

argumentDescriptions.count: Thinking activity entries represented by the icon.

chat.attachment.document.description: Accessibility description for an attached document.

chat.attachment.file.description: Accessibility description for an artifact returned by a tool.

chat.attachment.generic.description: Accessibility description for an attachment preview.

chat.attachment.image.description: Accessibility description for an image attachment or tool-result image.

chat.attachment.parseError.description: Accessibility description for malformed structured message content.

chat.attachment.previewUnavailable.description: Fallback shown when attachment image bytes cannot be rendered.

chat.attachment.remoteFile.description: Human-facing wrapper around a provider file identifier; do not translate the identifier.

argumentDescriptions.fileId: Opaque provider file identifier; preserve it.

chat.attachment.url.description: Accessibility description for a link returned by a tool. Keep URL as a technical acronym where appropriate.

chat.compaction.migration.description: Title for a compact context created during runtime/model migration.
chat.compaction.migration.translationNotes: Migration is transfer between AI runtimes/models; compact is the condensed context representation, not a contract or human relocation.

chat.compaction.policy.description: Title for compaction triggered by Gromozeka policy.

chat.compaction.provider.description: Title for provider-managed automatic context compaction.

chat.compaction.providerManaged.description: Human-readable description of an opaque compaction performed by the provider.

chat.compaction.tokensBefore.description: Token count before provider-managed context compaction.

argumentDescriptions.count: Provider-reported number of model-context tokens before compaction.

chat.compaction.tokensBefore.translationNotes: Tokens are model text units. They are not API authentication tokens or monetary credits.

chat.compaction.unknownProvider.description: Fallback provider display name in compaction metadata.

chat.compaction.userRequested.description: Title for context compaction explicitly requested by the user.

chat.developerPrompt.dataTypesTable.description: Built-in developer quick-action prompt asking for a programming data-type table.
chat.developerPrompt.dataTypesTable.translationNotes: This entry is a product-authored sample request translated for the built-in quick action. It must not be applied to existing user conversation text or personal prompts.

chat.developerPrompt.googleNews.description: Built-in developer quick-action prompt asking for current Google news; Google is the company name.
chat.developerPrompt.googleNews.translationNotes: This entry is a product-authored sample request translated for the built-in quick action. It must not be applied to existing user conversation text or personal prompts.

chat.developerPrompt.listFiles.description: Built-in developer quick-action prompt. Keep the shell command ls unchanged.
chat.developerPrompt.listFiles.translationNotes: This entry is a product-authored sample request translated for the built-in quick action. It must not be applied to existing user conversation text or personal prompts.

chat.developerPrompt.tongueTwister.description: Built-in developer quick-action prompt sent as a new message, originally Russian. This is product-authored content; never apply this catalog entry to existing user messages.
chat.developerPrompt.tongueTwister.translationNotes: This entry is a product-authored sample request translated for the built-in quick action. It must not be applied to existing user conversation text or personal prompts.

chat.dialog.close.description: Accessibility description for closing the raw JSON dialog.

chat.editMessage.title.description: Dialog title for editing an existing conversation message.

chat.error.dismiss.description: Accessibility label for dismissing an error card.

chat.error.dismissInfo.description: Accessibility label for dismissing an informational card.

chat.error.dismissWarning.description: Accessibility label for dismissing a warning card.

chat.error.retry.description: Button to retry a failed action.

chat.error.title.description: Error card heading and accessibility label for a chat error.

chat.history.scrollToLatest.description: Accessibility description for returning to the newest conversation activity.

chat.history.unreadMessages.description: Complete unread-message button text. Replace the concatenation of unreadCount and runtime.newMessagesLabel; zero uses existing runtime.newActivityLabel.

argumentDescriptions.count: Number of new unread messages below the current scroll position.

chat.input.attachFiles.description: Tooltip and accessibility description for adding draft attachments.

chat.input.hideKeyboard.description: Tooltip and accessibility description for dismissing the on-screen keyboard.

chat.input.insertLocation.description: Tooltip for inserting the current device location into the message draft.

chat.input.insertLocationShort.description: Short accessibility description for the location insertion button.

chat.input.queue.description: Send-button tooltip while the agent is responding; queues the draft at its selected safe point.
chat.input.queue.translationNotes: Queue means defer delivery of this draft until a safe point in active agent execution. It does not mean the message has already been sent.

chat.input.queueWithPending.description: Send-button tooltip while a response is running and messages are already queued. Original hardcoded text is Russian.

argumentDescriptions.count: Number of user messages already waiting in the queue before this draft is added.

chat.input.removeAttachment.description: Accessibility description for removing an attachment from the draft; preserve the filename.

argumentDescriptions.fileName: Filename of the draft attachment being removed; preserve its spelling and extension.

chat.input.send.description: Short accessibility description for the send/queue message button.

chat.location.current.description: App-generated wrapper inserted into the draft. Details preserve invariant latitude/longitude/accuracyMeters/altitudeMeters/provider/capturedAt fields and numeric values; do not translate those technical keys.

argumentDescriptions.details: Invariant device-location field list; preserve technical keys, numbers, units, coordinates, and timestamps.

chat.location.current.translationNotes: This product-authored wrapper is inserted into a new editable message draft. Do not rewrite existing user messages or translate the invariant location field keys.

chat.location.reason.disabled.description: Display label for DeviceLocationUnavailableReason.LOCATION_DISABLED in generated draft text.

chat.location.reason.error.description: Display label for DeviceLocationUnavailableReason.ERROR in generated draft text.

chat.location.reason.permissionDenied.description: Display label for DeviceLocationUnavailableReason.PERMISSION_DENIED in generated draft text.

chat.location.reason.timeout.description: Display label for DeviceLocationUnavailableReason.TIMEOUT in generated draft text.

chat.location.reason.unsupported.description: Display label for DeviceLocationUnavailableReason.UNSUPPORTED in generated draft text.

chat.location.unavailable.description: App-generated text inserted into the editable message draft when location acquisition fails. Reason is a translated device-location failure label.

argumentDescriptions.reason: Already translated device-location failure reason, such as permission denied.

chat.location.unavailableWithMessage.description: Location failure inserted into the draft with optional platform details; preserve platform message content.

argumentDescriptions.message: Platform-provided location error detail; preserve its text rather than translating arbitrary diagnostic content.
argumentDescriptions.reason: Already translated device-location failure reason, such as permission denied.

chat.mention.notParticipating.description: Agent membership status in mention suggestions. Indicates whether the agent participates in this conversation, not network connectivity or online presence.

chat.mention.participating.description: Agent membership status in mention suggestions. Indicates whether the agent participates in this conversation, not network connectivity or online presence.

chat.navigation.agents.description: Navigation tab label, tooltip, and accessibility description for the agent catalog.

chat.navigation.conversationFallback.description: Fallback tab title when the conversation is not loaded.

chat.navigation.live.description: Short tab label and accessibility description for live interpretation.
chat.navigation.live.translationNotes: Live labels the real-time speech interpretation feature, not a live broadcast, a living being, or a production environment.

chat.navigation.liveInterpreter.description: Tooltip for the live speech interpretation tab.
chat.navigation.liveInterpreter.translationNotes: Interpreter means a spoken-language interpreter here, not a programming-language interpreter.

chat.navigation.renameTab.description: Accessibility label for renaming a conversation tab.

chat.selection.assistantMessages.description: Filter label selecting assistant message content.

chat.selection.concat.description: Compact action name for concatenating selected messages; also used in operation status.
chat.selection.concat.translationNotes: Concat means concatenate/join selected messages directly without an AI model; use established software wording, not an unrelated literal abbreviation.

chat.selection.concatHint.description: Tooltip for joining selected messages without a model call.

chat.selection.delete.description: Button label and accessibility description for deleting selected messages.

chat.selection.deleteHint.description: Tooltip for deleting selected conversation messages.

chat.selection.distill.description: Action label for model-assisted context distillation; also used in operation status.
chat.selection.distill.translationNotes: Distill means extract essential context with an AI model for context transfer; this is not chemical distillation and differs from a conventional history summary.

chat.selection.distillHint.description: Tooltip for model-assisted extraction of essential context from selected messages.

chat.selection.editHint.description: Tooltip for editing the one selected message.

chat.selection.operationComplete.description: Successful message-squash status; action is a translated action name.

argumentDescriptions.action: Already translated name of the message transformation, Concat, Distill, or Summarize.

chat.selection.operationFailed.description: Failed message-squash status. Preserve the operation error message as data.

argumentDescriptions.action: Already translated name of the message transformation, Concat, Distill, or Summarize.
argumentDescriptions.message: Underlying error or source message supplied by the operation; preserve it as data.

chat.selection.operationRunning.description: Status of the running message-squash operation; action is a translated Concat, Distill, or Summarize label.

argumentDescriptions.action: Already translated name of the message transformation, Concat, Distill, or Summarize.

chat.selection.plainMessages.description: Filter label selecting ordinary plain-message blocks.

chat.selection.selectedCount.description: Count of selected messages in the selection toolbar.

argumentDescriptions.count: Number of conversation messages selected in the selection toolbar.

chat.selection.summarize.description: Action label for model-assisted message summarization; also used in operation status.
chat.selection.summarize.translationNotes: Summarize means compress selected message history into an AI-generated summary. Keep it distinct from distilling essential context for transfer.

chat.selection.summarizeHint.description: Tooltip for model-assisted summarization of selected messages.

chat.selection.thinkingBlocks.description: Filter label selecting visible/opaque assistant thinking content.

chat.selection.toggleAll.description: Selection toolbar toggle for all message kinds.

chat.selection.toolCalls.description: Filter label selecting assistant tool-call content.

chat.selection.userMessages.description: Filter label selecting messages authored by users.

chat.suggestions.regenerate.description: Accessibility label for requesting another set of suggested replies.

chat.tool.agent.description: Expanded create-agent parameters. Preserve the configured agent name.

argumentDescriptions.agentName: Configured AI agent display name; preserve the user-defined name.

chat.tool.charactersOmitted.description: Marker inserted when long tool output exceeds the character limit.

argumentDescriptions.count: Number of omitted characters between retained tool-output fragments.

chat.tool.command.description: Expanded command-tool parameters. Do not translate command contents.

argumentDescriptions.command: Shell command being executed; preserve code, arguments, flags, and syntax.

chat.tool.contentBytes.description: Tool write-content size below one kilobyte. Existing implementation counts characters, not encoded bytes; integration must resolve this semantics.

argumentDescriptions.count: Content size labelled as bytes by the existing code; integration must reconcile current character counting with encoded-byte size.

chat.tool.dataTruncation.description: Truncated non-text document data; prefix/suffix are unchanged data and count is the omitted character count.

argumentDescriptions.count: Number of characters omitted from the middle of the tool-result document data.
argumentDescriptions.prefix: Unchanged initial fragment of the tool-result data before the omission marker.
argumentDescriptions.suffix: Unchanged final fragment of the tool-result data after the omission marker.

chat.tool.fileParameter.description: Expanded tool parameter label for a file path. Preserve the path and use left-to-right isolation when appropriate.

argumentDescriptions.path: File or directory path shown by the tool; preserve separators and file names.

chat.tool.initialMessage.description: Expanded create-agent parameters; message is an unchanged, possibly truncated preview.

argumentDescriptions.message: Unchanged, possibly truncated initial message supplied to the new agent.

chat.tool.linesOmitted.description: Marker inserted between the beginning and end of long tool output. Surrounding blank lines should stay in the layout code.

argumentDescriptions.count: Number of omitted lines between retained tool-output fragments.

chat.tool.message.description: Expanded tell-agent message parameter. Do not translate message content.

argumentDescriptions.message: Unchanged message or instruction sent to another agent.

chat.tool.parametersError.description: Fallback when structured tool parameters cannot be rendered.

argumentDescriptions.message: Underlying parameter parsing/formatting error, preserved as diagnostic data.

chat.tool.project.description: Expanded create-agent parameters. Keep the project identifier unchanged.

chat.tool.query.description: Expanded web-search parameters. Preserve the user search query.

argumentDescriptions.query: User-supplied search query; preserve the query text.

chat.tool.replaceAll.description: Mode displayed for a file edit that replaces every match.

chat.tool.replaceAllSummary.description: Compact edit-file summary when all occurrences are replaced; preserve the path.

argumentDescriptions.path: File or directory path shown by the tool; preserve separators and file names.

chat.tool.replaceFirst.description: Mode displayed for a file edit that replaces only the first match.

chat.tool.replacement.description: Edit-file parameter summary. The replaced and replacement text are user/tool content and must remain unchanged.

argumentDescriptions.newText: Replacement text; preserve it exactly as content.
argumentDescriptions.oldText: Original text selected for replacement; preserve it exactly as content.

chat.tool.replacement.translationNotes: Old/new text is untrusted source content; preserve it verbatim. Translate only the surrounding replacement explanation.

chat.tool.replacementMode.description: Complete line wrapping the already translated edit-file replacement mode.

argumentDescriptions.mode: Already translated file-edit replacement mode: replace all occurrences or replace first occurrence.

argumentDescriptions.count: Maximum requested number of search results, not the number already returned.

chat.tool.tabId.description: Expanded switch-tab parameter; preserve the identifier.

argumentDescriptions.tabId: Opaque tab identifier, possibly shortened for the compact display; preserve it.

chat.tool.tabSummary.description: Compact switch-tab summary using a shortened opaque tab identifier.

argumentDescriptions.tabId: Opaque tab identifier, possibly shortened for the compact display; preserve it.

chat.tool.targetTab.description: Expanded tell-agent target tab label; tabId is an opaque shortened identifier.

argumentDescriptions.tabId: Opaque tab identifier, possibly shortened for the compact display; preserve it.

chat.tool.timeout.description: Expanded command-tool timeout in seconds; translate the seconds abbreviation if customary.

argumentDescriptions.seconds: Duration or timeout measured in seconds; preserve the numeric quantity.

chat.tool.url.description: Expanded URL-reading parameters. Preserve the URL.

argumentDescriptions.url: URL being read; preserve it exactly.

chat.tool.usingNamedTool.description: Fallback activity caption for an unknown tool. Keep the external tool name readable without translating its technical identifier.

argumentDescriptions.toolName: Readable external tool name, already derived from its technical identifier; preserve the supplied name.

chat.tool.usingNamedTool.translationNotes: The tool name can be unknown/custom. Translate the action prefix; never invent translations of external wire identifiers.

chat.tool.workingDirectory.description: Expanded command-tool working directory label. Preserve the filesystem path.

argumentDescriptions.path: File or directory path shown by the tool; preserve separators and file names.

chat.tool.workspace.description: Expanded create-agent parameters. Keep the workspace identifier unchanged.

chat.tool.writeFileParameters.description: Complete parameter summary for writing a file; size is a localized number/unit string.

argumentDescriptions.path: File or directory path shown by the tool; preserve separators and file names.
argumentDescriptions.size: File-content size, with number and unit formatted separately for the locale.

chat.voice.continuous.finishHint.description: Instruction shown while speech is being captured.

chat.voice.continuous.listening.description: Fallback status while waiting for speech in continuous mode.

chat.voice.continuous.listeningPhrase.description: Status while the user is speaking one phrase in continuous voice mode.

chat.voice.continuous.queueHint.description: Instruction explaining automatic queueing when the user stops speaking.

chat.voice.continuous.ready.description: Fallback status when continuous voice input is available but idle.

chat.voice.continuous.start.description: Idle continuous-microphone button tooltip and accessibility label.
chat.voice.continuous.start.translationNotes: Continuous means the microphone remains available across phrases; this is separate from holding the push-to-talk button for one recording.

chat.voice.continuous.startHint.description: Instruction under the idle continuous-voice status.

chat.voice.continuous.starting.description: Continuous speech capture startup status and tooltip.

chat.voice.continuous.stop.description: Tooltip/accessibility label for stopping continuous microphone capture.

chat.voice.continuous.transcribingPhrase.description: Status while the just-captured phrase is being transcribed.

clearSearchText.description: Accessibility label for the button clearing the conversation search query.

client.attachment.activeWindowUnavailabl.description: The iOS client cannot find an active app window in which to present a document or screenshot chooser.

client.attachment.failed.description: Fallback error while acquiring/uploading an attachment.

client.attachment.filePickerAlreadyOpen.description: A second request to open the system document/file chooser was rejected because that chooser is already open.

client.attachment.filePickerUnavailable.description: The client cannot launch the system file chooser on this device. This is file selection for chat attachments, not server filesystem access.

client.attachment.fileTooLarge.description: Composer validation: one selected attachment exceeds the byte-size cap.

client.attachment.notAFile.description: Desktop attachment selection rejected an entry such as a directory because only regular files can be attached. The file argument is the original entry name, not its contents.

argumentDescriptions.file: Original file or directory name; preserve exactly as provided. Can contain spaces, Unicode, or an extension.

client.attachment.readFailed.description: An attachment file could not be opened or read. The file argument is its original filename (or a localized generic attachment label if no filename exists). Do not translate the filename.

argumentDescriptions.file: Original file or directory name; preserve exactly as provided. Can contain spaces, Unicode, or an extension.

client.attachment.screenshotFailed.description: The screenshot attachment could not be acquired: capture, image encoding, or reading an existing screenshot failed. Shared across browser, desktop, and iOS screenshot selection.

client.attachment.screenshotPickerAlread.description: The iOS screenshot photo-library chooser is already open; the user requested another one. This chooser selects an existing screenshot.

client.attachment.screenshotUnavailable.description: The device or browser does not offer screen capture for creating a chat attachment. This is screenshot capture, not video recording.

client.attachment.tooMany.description: Composer validation: too many attached files. Count is the maximum permitted number, not the current number.

client.attachment.totalTooLarge.description: Composer validation: combined size of all files attached to one message exceeds the cap.

argumentDescriptions.limit: Maximum combined size expressed in megabytes

client.instructions.inputContext.description: History chip marking metadata about how the message was entered (typed or speech-to-text). It does not display the actual message content.

client.instructions.liveSteering.description: History chip for a built-in instruction: a user message arrived while the agent was working and should guide the ongoing turn at the next safe boundary. This is an additional instruction, not an update to software or a voice transcript.

client.instructions.messageTime.description: History chip marking metadata about when the user sent the message.

client.instructions.previousInterrupted.description: History chip stating that the user interrupted the previous agent turn; operations may have been partially cancelled. Preserve distinction from stop.

client.instructions.previousStopped.description: History chip stating that the user deliberately stopped the previous agent turn before normal completion. Preserve distinction from interrupt.

client.instructions.readOnly.description: Default instruction button: Agent may inspect but must not make changes. This is not a filesystem permission attribute.

client.instructions.readOnlyDescription.description: Tooltip explaining the built-in read-only instruction. Localize only displayed standard wording; do not rewrite saved model prompts.

client.instructions.readOnlyShort.description: Very compact visible composer button for read-only mode. Choose a recognizable short abbreviation or retain R; full tooltip explains it. Does not change keyboard aliases.

client.instructions.responseExpected.description: History chip telling an agent that another agent expects a response. This is not a UI waiting status.

client.instructions.revealedSecrets.description: History chip marking secrets explicitly approved by the user for inclusion in this model request. The label never includes secret values.

client.instructions.userSituation.description: History chip marking runtime facts about the user’s current situation, such as device context.

client.instructions.workspaceContext.description: History chip marking workspace paths explicitly selected by the user for the message.

client.instructions.writable.description: Default instruction button: user permits Agent to change files.

client.instructions.writableDescription.description: Tooltip explaining the built-in file-editing permission instruction.

client.instructions.writableShort.description: Very compact visible composer button permitting file edits. Choose a recognizable short abbreviation or retain W; full tooltip explains it. Does not change keyboard aliases.

client.instructions.writeAccess.description: Default composer instruction group controlling whether the Agent may change files. Display localization only; do not overwrite customized stored group titles.

client.mention.failed.description: Fallback composer error when determining which mentioned Agent to invoke failed.

client.mention.noAutomaticResponse.description: Composer hint: posting saves the user's message but does not automatically invoke an Agent.

client.mention.notConnected.description: Mentioned Agent is not a participant of this conversation. Connected means participant membership, not network connectivity.

client.mention.onlyOneAgent.description: Validation error when one message explicitly mentions several Agents; only one explicit responder can be invoked.

argumentDescriptions.mentions: Literal @Agent mentions, possibly with #id suffix; do not modify.

client.mention.replies.description: Composer hint listing the Agents who will answer this message. Replies is a verb/heading meaning these Agents will respond, not a count of existing replies.

argumentDescriptions.agents: User-created Agent display names, comma separated; preserve names.

client.message.initial.description: Product-authored initial user message when starting a project without supplied text. Translate only newly generated text, never stored history.

client.message.noLongerAvailable.description: Editing failed because the selected stored message disappeared or was deleted.

client.message.rejected.description: Server rejected a request to enqueue/post a user message. Not a model safety refusal.

client.message.selectAtLeastTwo.description: Validation hint: merging/distilling/summarizing selected messages requires two or more selected messages.

client.message.submissionFailed.description: Fallback error for sending/enqueuing a user message.

client.serverAddress.credentials.description: Validation error beneath the server address input during setup/settings. Explain the URL requirement; preserve URL schemes, /ws and IPv6 syntax literally. Server address must not contain credentials

client.serverAddress.empty.description: Validation error beneath the server address input during setup/settings. Explain the URL requirement; preserve URL schemes, /ws and IPv6 syntax literally. Server address must not be empty

client.serverAddress.host.description: Validation error beneath the server address input during setup/settings. Explain the URL requirement; preserve URL schemes, /ws and IPv6 syntax literally. Server address must include a host

client.serverAddress.invalidIpv6.description: Validation error beneath the server address input during setup/settings. Explain the URL requirement; preserve URL schemes, /ws and IPv6 syntax literally. Server address contains an invalid IPv6 host

client.serverAddress.invalidPort.description: Validation error beneath the server address input during setup/settings. Explain the URL requirement; preserve URL schemes, /ws and IPv6 syntax literally. Server address contains an invalid port

client.serverAddress.invalidSuffix.description: Validation error beneath the server address input during setup/settings. Explain the URL requirement; preserve URL schemes, /ws and IPv6 syntax literally. Server address contains invalid text after the host

client.serverAddress.ipv6Brackets.description: Validation error beneath the server address input during setup/settings. Explain the URL requirement; preserve URL schemes, /ws and IPv6 syntax literally. IPv6 server addresses must use square brackets

client.serverAddress.path.description: Validation error beneath the server address input during setup/settings. Explain the URL requirement; preserve URL schemes, /ws and IPv6 syntax literally. Server address path must be empty or /ws

client.serverAddress.query.description: Validation error beneath the server address input during setup/settings. Explain the URL requirement; preserve URL schemes, /ws and IPv6 syntax literally. Server address must not contain a query or fragment

client.serverAddress.scheme.description: Validation error beneath the server address input during setup/settings. Explain the URL requirement; preserve URL schemes, /ws and IPv6 syntax literally. Server address must use http://, https://, ws://, or wss://

client.serverAddress.whitespace.description: Validation error beneath the server address input during setup/settings. Explain the URL requirement; preserve URL schemes, /ws and IPv6 syntax literally. Server address must not contain whitespace

client.voice.audioProcessorFailed.description: The browser AudioWorklet processor failed while processing microphone audio. Recording/transcription input failed, not playback.

client.voice.audioReadFailed.description: Native audio reader failed; preserve the diagnostic code literally.

client.voice.audioReadFailedGeneric.description: A browser FileReader could not read captured microphone PCM audio. No native diagnostic code is available for this known failure.

client.voice.microphoneDenied.description: OS microphone permission was denied by the user/system.

client.voice.microphoneFormatUnsupported.description: Microphone recording failed because the Android audio input cannot supply the required audio format. Preserve 16 kHz and PCM16 as technical literals; mono means one audio channel.

client.voice.microphoneInitializationFai.description: Native microphone initialization failed before recording could begin.

client.voice.recordedFileMissing.description: The native recorder's audio file cannot be located or opened.

client.whisper.disabled.description: Client-side live interpreting requires the Local Whisper speech-to-text engine to be selected. Local Whisper is a product/integration name, not a person.

client.whisper.inferenceFailed.description: The local whisper-server HTTP endpoint rejected a transcription request. status is the HTTP code, diagnostic is an unchanged truncated response body.

client.whisper.lowLatency.description: Whisper audio chunking profile optimized for a short delay before results. Latency means response delay, not low sound volume.

client.whisper.modelMissing.description: The configured or default local Whisper model file is absent. file is its path; command is a shell command to download the model. Translate prose only, never either argument.

client.whisper.serverExited.description: The local whisper-server process exited during startup before its HTTP endpoint became ready. code is a numeric process exit code.

client.whisper.startFailed.description: The desktop client failed to launch the local whisper-server process. executable is the configured command/path; error is unmodified OS diagnostic text.

client.whisper.startupTimedOut.description: The desktop client waited count seconds for the local whisper-server process to become ready and timed out.

settingsUi.pathOrCommandNameForWhisperCp.description: Explains how the configured whisper-cli command is resolved and how its sibling whisper-server executable is started. Preserve executable names.
settingsUi.pathOrCommandNameForWhisperCp.literal: Path or command name for whisper.cpp CLI. Gromozeka starts the sibling whisper-server executable.

settingsUi.portableZIP.description: Artifact-format label for a portable ZIP distribution rather than an operating-system installer.

settingsUi.pressKeys.description: Temporary instruction while the shortcut editor waits for the user to press a new key combination.

settingsUi.prompt.description: Editable instruction text telling the AI how to transform selected or clipboard text; this is not a UI input prompt or dialog title.

settingsUi.providerVAD.description: Voice activity detection option in which the speech provider determines speech boundaries. VAD means voice activity detection.
settingsUi.providerVAD.terminologyNotes: VAD = voice activity detection. Keep the acronym or introduce the locale-standard expansion consistently; provider means the configured speech service.

settingsUi.pushToTalk.description: Keyboard action for holding a key to record speech and releasing it to transcribe and send or insert the result.

settingsUi.quickTextActions.description: Heading for AI transformations of selected or clipboard text, shared between desktop shortcuts and mobile quick actions.

settingsUi.quickTextRuntimeNoAgent.description: Dropdown option using the purpose-specific Quick text model configuration without selecting an Agent.

settingsUi.recordOnThisClientOrOnOneExac.description: Explains that audio may be recorded on this UI device or a specifically identified Worker while transcription executes on a different machine.
settingsUi.recordOnThisClientOrOnOneExac.literal: Record on this client or on one exact Worker. The transcription backend may run elsewhere.

settingsUi.remoteProtocol.description: Dropdown choosing the wire encoding used by client-server communication, not an AI provider protocol or tool permission.

settingsUi.removeConfiguredAPIKey.description: Button marking the stored API key for removal on save; it is not a request to revoke the key at its provider.

settingsUi.requiresAnOrganizationApprove.description: Explains the required Claude.ai account login on the machine executing Claude Code voice; API credentials and the listed cloud-provider routes do not qualify. Preserve product names.
settingsUi.requiresAnOrganizationApprove.literal: Requires an organization-approved Claude.ai login on the execution target; API keys, Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry cannot use Claude voice.

settingsUi.resetScale.description: Button restoring both interface scale and text scale to their normal values.

settingsUi.restoreInterfaceAndTextScaleT.description: Explains that resetting scale restores both overall UI size and font size to 100 percent.
settingsUi.restoreInterfaceAndTextScaleT.literal: Restore interface and text scale to 100%.

settingsUi.retry.description: Button retrying the failed download-catalog request.

settingsUi.saveWebTools.description: Button persisting the edited web-tool configuration and pending credential changes to the Server.

settingsUi.scope.description: Dropdown label for where a keyboard shortcut is active: inside Gromozeka or system-wide. This is not a permission or memory scope.

settingsUi.security.description: Navigation category for authentication, access control, device approval, and stored credentials.

settingsUi.selectAClaudeCodeConnection.description: Placeholder shown before choosing a Claude Code connection for voice transcription.

settingsUi.separateAIRuntime.description: Suggested-reply mode using a separate purpose-specific AI invocation/configuration; it does not mean another Gromozeka installation or operating-system process.

settingsUi.server.description: Whisper execution target option for the central Gromozeka Server, not a Worker or the UI device.

settingsUi.serverAddress.description: Field for the central Gromozeka Server address that this client should connect to after restart.

settingsUi.servers.description: Distribution group for central Gromozeka Server packages.

settingsUi.sha256Checksums.description: Link to published SHA-256 hashes for verifying downloaded release artifacts. Preserve SHA-256.

settingsUi.shortcutConflict.description: Keyboard shortcut validation error: the same scope, key, and modifiers are assigned to multiple enabled actions.

argumentDescriptions.actions: Comma-separated localized names of the other conflicting actions

settingsUi.shortcutEscapeConsumed.description: Warning for global Escape bound with consume-event enabled: the shortcut blocks Escape from reaching the foreground application.

settingsUi.shortcutEscapeShared.description: Warning for global Escape bound with consume-event disabled: both Gromozeka and the foreground application receive Escape.

settingsUi.shortcutGlobalRequiresModifie.description: Keyboard shortcut validation error: global shortcuts need a modifier key such as Control unless the action is push-to-talk.

settingsUi.shortcutUnsupportedScope.description: Keyboard shortcut validation error: the selected action cannot run in the chosen scope (inside Gromozeka or globally). Action and scope are already localized display labels.

argumentDescriptions.action: Localized action name, for example New conversation
argumentDescriptions.scope: Localized shortcut scope, for example Global

settingsUi.speechToTextBackend.description: Dropdown label selecting the engine that converts recorded speech into text.

settingsUi.startsOrStopsContinuousVoiceI.description: Explains that this shortcut toggles the continuous voice listening session.
settingsUi.startsOrStopsContinuousVoiceI.literal: Starts or stops continuous voice input.

settingsUi.stickyReminder.description: Per-instruction-group switch label selecting sticky reminder behavior. Sticky means retain the latest selected instruction from that group in model context, not a desktop note or scheduled notification.

argumentDescriptions.group: Display name of the model-instruction group, potentially user-authored; do not translate arbitrary user data.

settingsUi.stickyReminderWarning.description: Warning that replacing sticky model instructions changes the prompt prefix and may invalidate prompt-cache reuse. A reminder here is persistent model context, not a scheduled notification.

settingsUi.suggestedReplies.description: Dropdown controlling generation of suggested user replies shown as clickable chips near an assistant response.

settingsUi.swallowKey.description: Switch consuming a push-to-talk keyboard event so the foreground application does not receive the key. Use the locale's standard term for suppressing a key event, not literal swallowing.

settingsUi.systemDefaultMicrophone.description: Display name for the built-in system-default microphone choice of a Worker audio input. Means the operating system default microphone; actual device names and user-provided names stay unchanged.

settingsUi.takeAScreenshotOfASelectedWin.description: Explains the theme-generation flow: capture a selected window, extract its colors with AI, and open an interactive Claude Code tab. Theme means interface colors.
settingsUi.takeAScreenshotOfASelectedWin.literal: Take a screenshot of a selected window and use AI to automatically generate a theme based on its colors. Opens a new tab with Claude Code for interactive theme generation.

settingsUi.theConfiguredAPIKeyWillBeRemo.description: Pending-change message after the user marks a stored API key for removal; actual removal occurs when changes are saved.
settingsUi.theConfiguredAPIKeyWillBeRemo.literal: The configured API key will be removed.

settingsUi.theNewAddressIsUsedAfterResta.description: Explains that a changed server address takes effect after client restart and that clearing it restores server selection at the next launch.
settingsUi.theNewAddressIsUsedAfterResta.literal: The new address is used after restarting this client. Clear it to choose a server on the next launch.

settingsUi.theseAgentAndPromptSettingsAp.description: Explains that the selected Agent and transformation prompt are reused by desktop hotkeys and mobile text actions.
settingsUi.theseAgentAndPromptSettingsAp.literal: These Agent and prompt settings apply to desktop hotkeys and mobile quick actions.

settingsUi.thisClient.description: Audio source option meaning the device running this Gromozeka UI, as distinct from a remote Worker or the central Server.

settingsUi.toggleContinuousVoice.description: Keyboard action starting or stopping continuous microphone listening; toggle is a switch between active and inactive states.

settingsUi.tokenExpiresAt.description: Expiration timestamp for a generated one-time Worker enrollment credential; this is not an AI usage token or quota reset time.

argumentDescriptions.time: Formatted expiration date and time of the one-time enrollment credential, not a duration.

settingsUi.tools.description: Navigation category for configurable tools available to agents, including web search and fetch.

settingsUi.transformationInstructionAppe.description: Explains that the quick-action transformation instruction follows the selected Agent's existing prompts in the model request.
settingsUi.transformationInstructionAppe.literal: Transformation instruction appended after the selected Agent prompts.

settingsUi.translateClipboardText.description: Keyboard action translating the text currently held in the system clipboard; this does not change the application's interface language.

settingsUi.translatesTheTextCurrentlySto.description: Explains that the translation action operates on current clipboard contents rather than the interface catalog.
settingsUi.translatesTheTextCurrentlySto.literal: Translates the text currently stored in the clipboard.

settingsUi.uiScale.description: Slider label for scaling the entire application interface, including controls and spacing.

settingsUi.unavailable.description: Suffix on a selected Claude Code connection whose configuration no longer exists. Preserve the leading space and separator when used as a suffix.

settingsUi.unavailableInput.description: Fallback label for a remembered Worker audio input whose hardware entry is currently unavailable.

argumentDescriptions.input: Exact identifier of the previously selected hardware audio input; preserve it unchanged.

settingsUi.unknown.description: Worker status fallback when the selected execution target is missing from the available Worker catalog.

settingsUi.unpackedExtensionZIP.description: Artifact-format label for a ZIP containing an extension intended to be loaded unpacked in a supported browser.

settingsUi.usage.description: Navigation category for AI provider usage and quota information.

settingsUi.useOpenAIWebSearchThroughThis.description: Description of enabling the native OpenAI web_search tool for models using this API-authenticated connection. Preserve web_search.
settingsUi.useOpenAIWebSearchThroughThis.literal: Use OpenAI web_search through this API connection when its model needs current information.

settingsUi.useOpenAIWebSearchThroughThis.description: Description of enabling the native OpenAI web_search tool for models using this subscription-authenticated connection. Preserve web_search.
settingsUi.useOpenAIWebSearchThroughThis.literal: Use OpenAI web_search through this subscription connection when its model needs current information.

settingsUi.usedWhenModelPathIsEmptyModel.description: Explains that the selected model name determines the expected weight-file location when no explicit model path is set. Preserve models/whisper/ggml-<name>.bin verbatim; <name> denotes the chosen model name.
settingsUi.usedWhenModelPathIsEmptyModel.literal: Used when model path is empty. Model is expected under Gromozeka home: models/whisper/ggml-<name>.bin

settingsUi.usesTheAgentModelRuntimeOverr.description: Explains which Agent configuration is reused for a quick text action while explicitly disabling tools and skills for the text-only transformation.
settingsUi.usesTheAgentModelRuntimeOverr.literal: Uses the Agent model, runtime overrides, prompts, and style. Tools and skills stay disabled for this text-only action.

settingsUi.voice.description: Navigation category for recording, speech recognition, and reading responses aloud.

settingsUi.voiceDisabled.description: Suffix on a Claude Code connection whose voice-transcription capability is disabled. Preserve the leading space and separator when used as a suffix.

settingsUi.webToolSettingsWillBecomeAvai.description: Explains why web-tool controls remain unavailable until the Server's AI configuration catalog has loaded.
settingsUi.webToolSettingsWillBecomeAvai.literal: Web tool settings will become available after the server catalog is loaded.

settingsUi.webTools.description: Heading for AI-accessible web search and page-fetching tool configuration.

settingsUi.whenEnabledTheForegroundAppli.description: Explains that consuming the push-to-talk key prevents the foreground application from reacting to that key while push-to-talk is active.
settingsUi.whenEnabledTheForegroundAppli.literal: When enabled, the foreground application does not receive this key while push-to-talk is active.

settingsUi.whisperExecutable.description: Field label for the whisper.cpp executable path or command name, not model data.

settingsUi.whisperExecutionTarget.description: Dropdown label choosing the Server or one specific Worker on which Whisper transcription executes.

settingsUi.whisperExtraArguments.description: Field label for advanced command-line arguments passed to whisper.cpp after required arguments.

settingsUi.whisperLiveProfile.description: Dropdown label for a preset controlling Whisper live-audio window and step timing; profile means a performance preset, not a person or account profile.
settingsUi.whisperLiveProfile.integrationNotes: LOW_LATENCY is localized separately by client.whisper.lowLatency in client.en.json; Balanced and Slow CPU are keys in this fragment.

settingsUi.whisperModel.description: Dropdown label choosing a Whisper speech recognition model by its distribution name, not a conversational AI model.

settingsUi.whisperModelPath.description: Optional filesystem path field for a Whisper speech recognition model weight file.

settingsUi.whisperProfileBalanced.description: Whisper live-audio performance preset balancing response delay and processing overhead; balanced refers to timing and CPU load, not sound balance or model impartiality.

settingsUi.whisperProfileLowLatency.description: Local Whisper live-audio performance preset prioritizing faster transcription updates with a shorter processing window and more frequent decoding than Balanced. Low latency means reduced delay before recognized speech appears, not a network connection setting.

settingsUi.whisperProfileSlowCpu.description: Whisper live-audio performance preset with larger windows for weaker CPUs, accepting more transcription delay to keep up with audio.

settingsUi.whisperThreads.description: Field label for the number of CPU computation threads used by Whisper; these are not chat threads or conversations.

settingsUi.withAnEmptyComposerOpensTheLa.description: Explains the condition for editing the previous message: the composer must be empty and a user message must still be editable.
settingsUi.withAnEmptyComposerOpensTheLa.literal: With an empty composer, opens the latest editable user message.

settingsUi.workerAudioInput.description: Dropdown label choosing a microphone or other audio input reported by the selected Worker process.

settingsUi.workerEnrollmentIsUnavailable.description: Message shown when this Server cannot provide Worker enrollment instructions or tokens.
settingsUi.workerEnrollmentIsUnavailable.literal: Worker enrollment is unavailable on this Server.

settingsUi.workerOffline.description: Worker connection state meaning the known execution process is currently disconnected from the Server.

settingsUi.workerOnline.description: Worker connection state meaning the execution process is currently connected and reporting to the Server.

settingsUi.workerStatus.description: Combined Worker identifier and connection status label used in audio-source and Whisper execution-target selectors.

argumentDescriptions.worker: Exact Worker identifier from the selected execution or audio source; preserve it as opaque user-visible data.
argumentDescriptions.status: Localized Worker connection-state label, currently online or offline, or the unknown fallback.

settingsUi.workers.description: Distribution group for Gromozeka Worker execution processes.

shortcuts.conflict.description: Validation error when another enabled action has the same key, modifiers, and activation scope as this shortcut.
shortcuts.conflict.literal: Shortcut conflicts with ${conflicts.filterNot { it.action == binding.action }.joinToString { it.action.name }}

argumentDescriptions.actions: Formatted list of localized display names for the other actions with the same shortcut, excluding the action currently being edited.

shortcuts.conflict.integrationNotes: The current message lists enum names. Integration should format a list of localized action display names.

shortcuts.escapeConsumed.description: Warning for a global Escape shortcut configured to consume the event: the application currently in front will not receive that Escape keystroke.
shortcuts.escapeConsumed.literal: Global Escape will prevent the foreground application from receiving Escape

shortcuts.escapeShared.description: Warning for a global Escape shortcut that also forwards the event: the application currently in front will receive the same Escape keystroke.
shortcuts.escapeShared.literal: Global Escape will also reach the foreground application

shortcuts.initializationFailed.description: Error while initializing the native operating-system service that registers global keyboard shortcuts; backend errors provide the diagnostic detail.

argumentDescriptions.error: Diagnostic message or platform fallback identifying why native global shortcut registration could not initialize.

shortcuts.initializationFailed.integrationNotes: Replaces platform-specific fallback messages with a shared localized wrapper and an error argument; preserve platform-specific diagnostic details.

shortcuts.modifierRequired.description: Validation error for a global shortcut without Ctrl, Alt, Shift, or Meta unless the action is push-to-talk. Modifiers means keyboard modifier keys.
shortcuts.modifierRequired.literal: Global shortcuts without modifiers are only allowed for push-to-talk

shortcuts.unavailable.description: Capability warning from a client with no global keyboard-shortcut implementation. Global means system-wide activation while another app has focus.
shortcuts.unavailable.literal: Global shortcuts are unavailable on this client

shortcuts.unsupportedScope.description: Validation error when a selected action is not supported in the chosen keyboard-shortcut activation scope.

argumentDescriptions.action: Localized keyboard action display name, such as Push to talk or Edit previous message.
argumentDescriptions.scope: Localized keyboard activation scope, such as Global or Inside Gromozeka; not a permission scope.

shortcuts.unsupportedScope.integrationNotes: The current message interpolates enum identifiers. Integration should pass localized action and scope display names.

shortcuts.waylandUnavailable.description: Capability warning when running on the Wayland display system, where this X11-based global keyboard shortcut implementation is unavailable. Preserve Wayland.
shortcuts.waylandUnavailable.literal: Global keyboard shortcuts are unavailable on Wayland

showJsonMenuItem.description: Legacy message-context-menu action opening the raw JSON representation of a message. JSON is the data format.
showJsonMenuItem.usageNotes: No current production reference to this typed property was found in presentation/src. The source points to its declaration; the described role is its retained catalog intent.

speakMenuItem.description: Legacy message-context-menu action reading a message aloud using text-to-speech. It does not ask the user to speak.
speakMenuItem.usageNotes: No current production reference to this typed property was found in presentation/src. The source points to its declaration; the described role is its retained catalog intent.

successClickToViewStatus.description: Legacy clickable tool-result status: execution succeeded and the user can open its result.
successClickToViewStatus.usageNotes: No current production reference to this typed property was found in presentation/src. The source points to its declaration; the described role is its retained catalog intent.

switchLanguage.description: Label of the interface-language selector in language settings; changes UI wording rather than speech recognition or the assistant's response language.

viewOriginalJson.description: Title of the dialog displaying the original JSON representation of a conversation message or result.

voice.availabilityFailed.description: Error while checking push-to-talk recording availability, including the configured capture or speech service, before recording starts.
voice.availabilityFailed.literal: Не удалось проверить доступность записи голоса: ${error.message}

argumentDescriptions.error: Diagnostic message from the recording-availability check failure.

voice.captureUnavailable.description: General availability failure for capturing microphone audio for speech-to-text. Unexpected technical diagnostic details may follow on a separate line.

voice.checkingAvailability.description: Temporary availability status while checking whether push-to-talk audio capture and its selected transcription backend can be used.

voice.checkingLiveAvailability.description: Temporary status while checking microphone, streaming support, and the selected continuous voice recognition mode.

voice.claudeConnectionMissing.description: The configured Claude Code speech-to-text connection is missing or has a different provider type. connection is the exact connection identifier.

voice.claudeConnectionNotConfigured.description: Claude Code is the selected speech-to-text engine, but no Claude Code AI connection was selected in speech settings.

voice.claudeDirectUnsupportedPlatform.description: Direct microphone capture through Claude Code is unsupported on the selected Worker operating system. platform is an operating system family identifier such as LINUX or WINDOWS, preserve it.

voice.claudeForwardingRequiresLinux.description: When recorded audio is forwarded to Claude Code instead of using its microphone directly, the execution target must run Linux.

voice.claudeRequiresWorker.description: Claude Code speech transcription must execute on a Worker. The Server cannot run this integration directly.

voice.claudeVoiceDisabled.description: The selected Claude Code connection has its voice transcription capability switched off. connection is the unchanged connection identifier.

voice.clientStreamingUnavailable.description: Capability error when the client cannot provide a live audio stream for rolling speech interpretation; this is not a network-video streaming message.
voice.clientStreamingUnavailable.literal: Client live audio streaming is not available on this platform

voice.clientSttUnavailable.description: Capability error from the unimplemented client-side speech recognition service, including use by live interpretation or push-to-talk.

voice.clientUploadUnavailable.description: The client cannot upload its own microphone audio while speech settings select a Worker microphone as the audio source. This does not refer to uploading file attachments.

voice.connectionDisabled.description: The selected speech-to-text AI connection is disabled in the runtime catalog. connection is its exact stable identifier, not a translated label.

voice.emptyPhrase.description: Status when a completed phrase yields only blank recognized text and is skipped without inserting or sending a chat message.

voice.emptyRecording.description: Error when the completed audio recording contains zero bytes, distinct from a nonempty recording that yields an empty transcript.

voice.emptyTranscript.description: Message when push-to-talk processing returns a blank transcript despite a completed recording; no message is sent or inserted.

voice.executableUnavailable.description: A required command-line program is absent from the selected Worker environment. executable is its exact command/path (for example ffmpeg); worker is an exact identifier.

voice.finishingRecording.description: Progress message when the user releases push-to-talk while capture is still starting; the controller waits for startup and then finishes that recording.

voice.listening.description: Local voice-detection status: the microphone is armed and waiting for speech, including after resuming from response playback.

voice.listeningPhrase.description: Local voice-detection status after speech begins: the current utterance is still being recorded and its phrase boundary has not yet been reached.

voice.liveNeedsClientMicrophone.description: Availability reason when continuous voice input is configured with a Worker audio source; this mode currently requires the current UI device's microphone.
voice.liveNeedsClientMicrophone.literal: Непрерывный голосовой ввод работает только с микрофоном текущего клиента

voice.liveNeedsStreaming.description: Availability reason when the client cannot supply microphone audio incrementally as streaming chunks. Streaming does not mean publishing a live broadcast.
voice.liveNeedsStreaming.literal: Непрерывный голосовой ввод требует потоковые audio chunks на клиенте

voice.liveStopped.description: Terminal error status when a failure ends the continuous voice input session.

argumentDescriptions.error: Diagnostic message from the failure that terminated continuous voice input.

voice.liveUnavailable.description: Capability message when the current client does not implement continuous voice input.
voice.liveUnavailable.literal: Непрерывный голосовой ввод недоступен на этом клиенте

voice.microphoneFailed.description: Error when preparing or opening the selected microphone recording session for push-to-talk fails.

argumentDescriptions.error: Diagnostic message from the microphone/capture initialization failure.

voice.noConversation.description: Message when recognized speech cannot be delivered because there is no active conversation tab; used by both push-to-talk and continuous voice input.
voice.noConversation.literal: Нет активного обсуждения для распознанного текста

voice.noiseDiscarded.description: Status when local voice detection rejects a very short sound as insufficient speech and resumes waiting; noise means an audio event, not irrelevant text.

voice.phraseTranscriptionFailed.description: Error for one phrase's speech-recognition request; this does not by itself mean the entire continuous listening session has ended.

argumentDescriptions.error: Diagnostic message from the individual phrase transcription request.

voice.providerAvailabilityFailed.description: Error while checking whether the configured provider supports the explicit provider-VAD mode, before continuous capture starts.
voice.providerAvailabilityFailed.terminologyNotes: Provider VAD means voice activity detection performed by the configured speech service. Translate the concept consistently and retain or expand VAD according to locale conventions.

argumentDescriptions.error: Diagnostic message from the provider-VAD capability check.

voice.providerListening.description: Provider voice-detection status: the speech service is waiting for a new spoken phrase, initially or after the previous phrase completes.
voice.providerListening.terminologyNotes: Provider VAD means voice activity detection performed by the configured speech service. Translate the concept consistently and retain or expand VAD according to locale conventions.

voice.providerListeningPhrase.description: Provider voice-detection status after the service reports that speech has started; audio for the current phrase is still being received.
voice.providerListeningPhrase.terminologyNotes: Provider VAD means voice activity detection performed by the configured speech service. Translate the concept consistently and retain or expand VAD according to locale conventions.

voice.providerRequiresOpenAi.description: Provider VAD requires both the OpenAI API speech-to-text engine and an OpenAI API connection. Do not confuse the API with an OpenAI Subscription connection.

voice.providerStopped.description: Terminal error status when provider-based voice detection or its streaming session fails. This mode stops rather than silently changing to local VAD.
voice.providerStopped.terminologyNotes: Provider VAD means voice activity detection performed by the configured speech service. Translate the concept consistently and retain or expand VAD according to locale conventions.

argumentDescriptions.error: Failure message from the speech provider or the local provider-streaming session.

voice.providerTranscribing.description: Provider status after speech stops and the service starts producing the completed phrase's transcript.
voice.providerTranscribing.terminologyNotes: Provider VAD means voice activity detection performed by the configured speech service. Translate the concept consistently and retain or expand VAD according to locale conventions.

voice.providerTranscriptionInProgress.description: Provider status when partial transcript text is arriving but the completed phrase transcript has not yet been delivered.
voice.providerTranscriptionInProgress.terminologyNotes: Provider VAD means voice activity detection performed by the configured speech service. Translate the concept consistently and retain or expand VAD according to locale conventions.

voice.providerUnavailable.description: General availability failure for provider-side voice activity detection (Provider VAD). Unexpected configuration or provider diagnostics may follow separately. Provider VAD is a feature label, not a provider name.

voice.realtimeRequiresServer.description: Long-lived OpenAI realtime transcription can run only on the Server. The speech-to-text AI connection must target the Server, not a Worker. Server is the product architecture role.

voice.recognitionFailed.description: Error shown after a push-to-talk recording or its speech-to-text request fails; no recognized text can be delivered from that attempt.

argumentDescriptions.error: Diagnostic message from the failed recording/transcription attempt; preserve provider or exception text as runtime data.

voice.sourceWorkerMissing.description: The selected microphone belongs to a Worker that no longer exists in the runtime catalog. worker is its unchanged identifier.

voice.speakingSuppressed.description: Status while an assistant response is being read aloud and microphone audio is temporarily ignored to avoid feedback. The implementation suppresses incoming chunks; this is not a claim that the OS microphone is disabled.

voice.startingLive.description: Progress status while opening the microphone and starting a continuous voice listening session.

voice.sttAvailabilityFailed.description: Error while checking the speech recognition backend for local-VAD continuous voice input.
voice.sttAvailabilityFailed.literal: Не удалось проверить доступность распознавания голоса: ${error.message}

argumentDescriptions.error: Diagnostic message from the speech-recognition availability check.

voice.sttDisabled.description: Availability reason when speech-to-text is switched off in settings, not a report of broken microphone hardware.

voice.transcribingPhrase.description: Local-VAD mode status while one completed audio phrase is being converted into text by the configured speech recognizer.

voice.transcriptionQueued.description: Status after a completed spoken phrase is queued for speech recognition; it has not necessarily been transcribed or sent as a chat message yet.

voice.transcriptionWorkerMissing.description: The Worker selected to perform speech-to-text processing is absent from the catalog. This Worker may differ from the Worker with the microphone.

voice.unavailable.description: Capability message when this client's push-to-talk recording implementation is unavailable; this is not an empty recording or a transcription error.

voice.workerAudioRequired.description: A Worker capture operation was requested but the selected audio source is the current client microphone. The user must select a microphone attached to the chosen Worker.

voice.workerInputUnavailable.description: The selected Worker does not advertise the selected microphone/audio input. input and worker are unchanged identifiers, not natural language.
